messages:
maria.g: Quick sync — need owners for customer-facing follow-ups after last night's partial outage. Who can own the 72h summary and statuspage copy?
ryan.k: I can take statuspage copy and add a short recurrence sentence. Will avoid infra jargon.
samir.b: I'll own the RCA-sharing policy draft and a redaction checklist.
beth: Looping in @olivia.p for legal review on sharing policy + consent language.
olivia.p: Will review; aim to return comments by tomorrow EOD.
maria.g: Must-haves: 1) 72h non-technical customer summary, 2) statuspage headline + short note on recurrence, 3) clear rule-set for full vs redacted RCAs.
ryan.k: Draft statuspage line (v0): "Partial disruption to hosted inference (Mar 24, 2026) — some customers experienced service delays after a configuration rollout. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. A customer summary will be published within 72 hours."
maria.g: Good. Replace 'configuration rollout' with 'recent configuration change' and keep it high-level.
samir.b: Proposed sharing rules: full internal RCA = internal only; enterprise customers may request deeper technical materials under documented consent/NDA; redacted customer summary = publish within 72 hours; detailed timeline + mitigations = available within 7 business days (redacted). Redaction checklist: remove PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, security-control specifics.
olivia.p: Legally acceptable. Require a consent record for any deeper attachments and include a checkbox in the support flow.
beth: I'll draft the consent checkbox language and an opt-in for bridge calls.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-5101 "Publish 72h customer summary" — assignee: maria.g — due: 1770390000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-5102 "Statuspage update: customer-facing copy" — assignee: ryan.k — due: 1770250000
samir.b: I'll add COMMS-5103 for the policy doc and link INFRA-772 for recurring-instance tracking. This is the third related cache-class tail event in six weeks — include a public sentence: "We are investigating a recurring class of service spikes and will share mitigations when validated."
maria.g: Owners recap: statuspage + recurrence line = ryan.k; 72h public summary = maria.g; RCA policy + checklist = samir.b; consent template + legal = beth + olivia.p.
ryan.k: Will PR statuspage once legal signs off and tag support for wording sync.
maria.g: Please post the 72h draft back here for quick review. Keep customer language consistent across channels. End.
